dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Symmetrical and gradual geometric narrowing of the dorsal profile from the widest visible portion of the mid-back toward the posterior peduncle.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: Off-white to mature white; the dorsal surface is divided by a sharp longitudinal shadow, causing the left half to appear slate-grey and the right half to appear near-white.

other_distinctive_markers: A highly pronounced, sharp, and linear dorsal ridge creates a distinct geometric and lighting boundary along the central longitudinal axis.
